name: Kingdom Hearts Re:coded Melon Mix
summary: Kingdom Hearts Re:Coded Melon Mix is a fan-developed project that enhances the original Nintendo DS title, Kingdom Hearts Re:Coded, for a modern PC gameplay experience. Utilizing a modified version of the melonDS emulator, Melon Mix refines the game by adapting its dual-screen interface into a single-screen display suitable for widescreen monitors. Key improvements include significantly upscaled graphics for a cleaner visual presentation, and reconfigured controls to support standard gamepads, notably enabling right-analog stick camera operation.
